Pretty good, and Hai is a nice guy, but not worth an out-of-the-way trip
Sep 2016 • Couples
We first went here because of the Eating Saigon blog, back when Hai was still living in Vietnam. Hai is a really nice and friendly guy, and there is nothing wrong with the food he serves (clay pot fish), but we felt disappointed by the distance we'd gone out to this place, because it's not particularly special or innovative there are lots of other comparable restaurants much closer in Q1 and Q3. Now we sometimes stop by when we're in Binh Thanh for the good clay pot fish, but I don't think it's worth making a big deal of coming to this place. As a neighborhood eatery if you're in the area, it's great. As a destination restaurant that you travel across the city (or across the world) to visit, no, there's nothing special about it. You can very likely find a very similar place in any neighborhood in Vietnam.

johnsobenj
Lower Hutt, New Zealand57 contributions
0
Absolutely worth the trip from District 1
Apr 2015
The very first day we arrived in Vietnam my wife and I made a beeline for Dong Hoa Xuan which is situated a decently long way from our hotel in District 1, on high recommendation from Eating Saigon blog. The taxi there and back was $12USD return. We have been in Vietnam for a week now (our trip is 4 weeks in total) and it is still the best food we've come across. In a way it's ruined us for food since eating there. Even though Vietnamese food elsewhere has been great, excellent even, this one restaurant produces the most flavoursome, beautiful, interesting food we've ever tasted.

In the end we returned two days later, squeezing one last lunch in before catching our bus down to the Mekong. Again, that mad rush around town was well worth it.

Over our two meals we had the following dishes:

- Cá Lóc Kho Tô: caramelised catfish. This is an absolute must-have dish. This will rock your world.
- Suon Non Nuong: amazing pork ribs!
- Cá Thu Sôt Cà: tomato fish dish, which again, is amazing!
- Com Tâm: south-Vietnamese 'broken rice'. Great base to eat with all the dishes.
- Canh Cai Nhung Voi Thit Xay: a mellow yet tasty 'vegetable soup' (we're sure it had traces of meat!) to finish off afterwards.

If you are in Saigon, and only have time for one meal, it should be here. Seriously! You know what they say, the most authentic food is the furthest from the tourist district.

reviews.review_text:
jonathantweed
usa102 contributions
0
worth the quick trip from district 1 for authentic local cuisine...
Dec 2013 • Family
we were feeling a bit frustrated with the tourist centric restaurants in district 1 and having trouble finding really local restaurants we decided to explore the other districts.

we read about Dong Hoa Xuan first on the eating saigon blog and then on trip advisor ... the overwhelmingly positive reviews compelled us to hop in a taxi and give it a try for an early lunch (this hidden gem closes at 2p).

first and foremost we were welcomed into this simple and very clean restaurant with a friendly smile from the manager, and then encouraged to look at all the freshly cooked food on offer (no menu necessary). we chose their famous caramelized fish, yummy stuffed tofu, some tasty sauteed green vegetables and some large fried whole sardines… everything was delicious and we plan on returning to try all of the other dishes on offer.

the complimentary iced green tea served by the friendly staff was the perfect drink to accompany our meal.

Dong Hoa Xuan was easy to find… the short taxi ride from district 1 was only 70k vnd in each direction.

if you are looking for an inexpensive AND deliciously authentic vietnamese meal this IS the real deal!

PS...don't miss the great dessert street food stall next door on your way out...
the Dong Hoa Xuan staff happily helped us choose from an assortment of vietnamese desserts for 10k vnd (less than 50 cents usd) each - we got the cubed banana "cake" in coconut sauce sprinkled with sesame seeds…yum!!

Simply AMAZING food!
Jun 2013 • Business
I live in NYC and I am working in Binh Than District for three weeks. Read about this restaurant on tripadvisor and found that it is right around the corner from the office. So, I tried it with some of the staff. They had never eaten there. After, two visits and a delivery. I am blown away by the food. My staff said they will definitely go back there. The caramelized fish is off the charts great! The smoke grilled pork was excellent especially with the sauce it is served with. It had me sucking the bone. I also had the mellon soup which was light and flavorful. Cold ice tea was refreshing. On my first visit, I got all three dishes and the drink for 55,000 dong. THAT IS RIGHT_55,000 DONG! Remember this is an open air restaurant without air but good fans. The food and EXCELLENT service made up for every bit no air conditioning.
